articles.title: Rupee rises 44 paise to 94.92 against US dollar in early trade
articles.excerpt:
The rupee appreciated 44 paise to 94.92 against US dollar in early trade on Wednesday, supported by Reserve Bank of India interventions designed to ease near-term dollar demand and limit speculative foreign exchange exposure.

Forex traders said the USD/INR pair, which has gained nearly 2 per cent in the last three trading sessions, opened on a positive note on Wednesday, largely driven by regulatory measures implemented by the RBI to limit volatility and curb speculative trading.

A sustained move below the 95.00 threshold opens potential toward 94.50, but ongoing external macroeconomic pressures are likely to temper further gains, they said.

articles.title: Global Market: Japan five-year bond yield steady after strong demand at auction
articles.excerpt:
Japan’s five-year government bond yield held steady at 2.34% on Wednesday after strong demand at a Ministry of Finance auction. Solid bid-to-cover ratios, easing French bond yields, and growing market expectations that the Bank of Japan is nearing the end of its rate hike cycle buoyed investor appetite.

articles.title: China sentences 3 more Myanmar crime bosses to death in scam centre crackdown
articles.excerpt:
Trio among 61 members sentenced from family-run Wei syndicate – one of the notorious ‘four families’ of northern Myanmar

They are among 61 members of the family-run Wei syndicate convicted of running massive cyber scam centres as well as illegal detention and extortion rings out of northern Myanmar targeting victims across China.

Three other key defendants – Wei Qingtao, Kang Min and Xiong Hengxing – were sentenced to life in prison, while 55 accomplices received fixed prison terms ranging from 39 months to 24 years.
